spec_text:
---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m1p3t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Surgeons, Slots

ASSUME Surgeons = 1 .. 3

VARIABLES token, book, crashed, passes

vars == <<token, book, crashed, passes>>

RingNext(s) == (s % 3) + 1

BookedSlots == { r.slot : r \in book }

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Surgeons
    /\ book \subseteq [ slot : Slots, by : Surgeons ]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Surgeons
    /\ passes \in 0 .. 6

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ book = {}
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ passes = 0

Claim(s) ==
    /\ token \notin crashed
    /\ s \notin BookedSlots
    /\ book' = book \cup { [ slot |-> s, by |-> token ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, crashed, passes >>

Pass ==
    /\ token \notin crashed
    /\ passes < 6
    /\ token' = RingNext(token)
    /\ passes' = passes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << book, crashed >>

Crash(x) ==
    /\ x \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 2
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup { x }
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, book, passes >>

SkipCrashed ==
    /\ token \in crashed
    /\ passes < 6
    /\ token' = RingNext(token)
    /\ passes' = passes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << book, crashed >>

Halt ==
    /\ passes = 6
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Claim(s)
    \/ Pass
    \/ \E x \in Surgeons : Crash(x)
    \/ SkipCrashed
    \/ Halt

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleBooking ==
    \A r1, r2 \in book : r1.slot = r2.slot => r1.by = r2.by
=============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m6p4t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Courses, Students, MaxCap, LeaseLen, MaxT

VARIABLES enrolled, leases, cap, clock

vars == <<enrolled, leases, cap, clock>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ enrolled \in [ Courses -> SUBSET Students ]
    /\ leases \subseteq [ course : Courses, student : Students, deadline : 0 .. MaxT + LeaseLen ]
    /\ cap \in [ Courses -> 0 .. MaxCap ]
    /\ clock \in 0 .. MaxT

Init ==
    /\ enrolled = [ c \in Courses |-> {} ]
    /\ leases = {}
    /\ cap = [ c \in Courses |-> 1 ]
    /\ clock = 0

Register(c, s) ==
    /\ s \notin enrolled[c]
    /\ Cardinality(enrolled[c]) < cap[c]
    /\ enrolled' = [ enrolled EXCEPT ![c] = @ \cup { s } ]
    /\ leases' = leases \cup { [ course |-> c, student |-> s, deadline |-> clock + LeaseLen ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << cap, clock >>

ExpireLease(r) ==
    /\ r \in leases
    /\ r.deadline <= clock
    /\ enrolled' = [ enrolled EXCEPT ![r.course] = @ \ { r.student } ]
    /\ leases' = leases \ { r }
    /\ UNCHANGED << cap, clock >>

AdjustCap(c, k) ==
    /\ k >= Cardinality(enrolled[c])
    /\ cap' = [ cap EXCEPT ![c] = k ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << enrolled, leases, clock >>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << enrolled, leases, cap >>

Idle ==
    /\ clock = MaxT
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Courses, s \in Students : Register(c, s)
    \/ \E r \in leases : ExpireLease(r)
    \/ \E c \in Courses, k \in 0 .. MaxCap : AdjustCap(c, k)
    \/ Tick
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected ==
    \A c \in Courses : Cardinality(enrolled[c]) <= cap[c]
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Courses = {c1, c2}
    Students = {s1, s2}
    MaxCap = 2
    LeaseLen = 2
    MaxT = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m0p2t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Fleet

VARIABLES amount, ver, msgs, granted

vars == <<amount, ver, msgs, granted>>

Places == { "holding", "runway", "departed" }

TypeOK ==
    /\ amount \in [ Places -> 0 .. Fleet ]
    /\ ver \in 0 .. Fleet
    /\ msgs \subseteq [ saw : 0 .. Fleet ]
    /\ granted \in 0 .. Fleet

Init ==
    /\ amount = [ p \in Places |-> IF p = "holding" THEN Fleet ELSE 0 ]
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ msgs = {}
    /\ granted = 0

Submit ==
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup { [ saw |-> ver ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << amount, ver, granted >>

Grant(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ m.saw = ver
    /\ amount["holding"] > 0
    /\ amount' = [ amount EXCEPT !["holding"] = @ - 1, !["runway"] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ granted' = granted + 1
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ { m }

Refresh(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ m.saw # ver
    /\ msgs' = (msgs \ { m }) \cup { [ saw |-> ver ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << amount, ver, granted >>

Depart ==
    /\ amount["runway"] > 0
    /\ amount' = [ amount EXCEPT !["runway"] = @ - 1, !["departed"] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, msgs, granted >>

Next ==
    \/ Submit
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Grant(m)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Refresh(m)
    \/ Depart

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FleetConserved ==
    amount["holding"] + amount["runway"] + amount["departed"] = Fleet
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Fleet = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FleetConserved

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m9p4t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Robots, Stations, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES assign, robotEpoch, epoch, syncs

vars == <<assign, robotEpoch, epoch, syncs>>

Occupancy(st) == Cardinality({ r \in Robots : assign[r] = st })

Cap == [ s \in Stations |-> IF s = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 ]

TypeOK ==
    /\ assign \in [ Robots -> Stations \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ robotEpoch \in [ Robots -> 0 .. MaxEpoch ]
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ syncs \in 0 .. 6

Init ==
    /\ assign = [ r \in Robots |-> 0 ]
    /\ robotEpoch = [ r \in Robots |-> 0 ]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ syncs = 0

Dock(r, st) ==
    /\ assign[r] = 0
    /\ robotEpoch[r] = epoch
    /\ Occupancy(st) < Cap[st]
    /\ assign' = [ assign EXCEPT ![r] = st ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << robotEpoch, epoch, syncs >>

Undock(r) ==
    /\ assign[r] # 0
    /\ assign' = [ assign EXCEPT ![r] = 0 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << robotEpoch, epoch, syncs >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << assign, robotEpoch, syncs >>

Sync(r) ==
    /\ robotEpoch[r] < epoch
    /\ syncs < 6
    /\ robotEpoch' = [ robotEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = epoch ]
    /\ syncs' = syncs + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << assign, epoch >>

Idle ==
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots, st \in Stations : Dock(r, st)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Undock(r)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Sync(r)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityOK ==
    \A st \in Stations : Occupancy(st) <= Cap[st]
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Robots = {r1, r2, r3}
    Stations = {1, 2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityOK

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m8p5t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Agents, Zones, Chutes, Bags

ZoneOf(c) == IF c <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2

VARIABLES zoneLock, chuteLock, log, admin

vars == <<zoneLock, chuteLock, log, admin>>

Range(s) == { s[i] : i \in DOMAIN s }

TypeOK ==
    /\ zoneLock \in [ Zones -> Agents \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ chuteLock \in [ Chutes -> Agents \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ log \in Seq(Bags)
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ zoneLock = [ z \in Zones |-> 0 ]
    /\ chuteLock = [ c \in Chutes |-> 0 ]
    /\ log = << >>
    /\ admin = FALSE

AcquireZone(a, z) ==
    /\ zoneLock[z] = 0
    /\ zoneLock' = [ zoneLock EXCEPT ![z] = a ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << chuteLock, log, admin >>

AcquireChute(a, c) ==
    /\ zoneLock[ZoneOf(c)] = a
    /\ chuteLock[c] = 0
    /\ chuteLock' = [ chuteLock EXCEPT ![c] = a ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << zoneLock, log, admin >>

ReleaseLocks(a) ==
    /\ zoneLock' = [ z \in Zones |-> IF zoneLock[z] = a THEN 0 ELSE zoneLock[z] ]
    /\ chuteLock' = [ c \in Chutes |-> IF chuteLock[c] = a THEN 0 ELSE chuteLock[c] ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << log, admin >>

Dispatch(a, bag) ==
    /\ \E c \in Chutes : chuteLock[c] = a /\ zoneLock[ZoneOf(c)] = a
    /\ bag \notin Range(log)
    /\ log' = Append(log, bag)
    /\ UNCHANGED << zoneLock, chuteLock, admin >>

AdminDispatch(bag) ==
    /\ admin = TRUE
    /\ bag \notin Range(log)
    /\ log' = Append(log, bag)
    /\ UNCHANGED << zoneLock, chuteLock, admin >>

ToggleAdmin ==
    /\ admin' = ~admin
    /\ UNCHANGED << zoneLock, chuteLock, log >>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Agents, z \in Zones : AcquireZone(a, z)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, c \in Chutes : AcquireChute(a, c)
    \/ \E a \in Agents : ReleaseLocks(a)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, bag \in Bags : Dispatch(a, bag)
    \/ \E bag \in Bags : AdminDispatch(bag)
    \/ ToggleAdmin

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleDispatch ==
    \A i, j \in DOMAIN log : log[i] = log[j] => i = j
=============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m2p1t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Banks

VARIABLES vote, decision, pstate, ledger

vars == <<vote, decision, pstate, ledger>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ vote \in [ Banks -> { "none", "yes", "no" } ]
    /\ decision \in { "none", "commit", "abort" }
    /\ pstate \in [ Banks -> { "working", "committed", "aborted" } ]
    /\ ledger \in [ Banks -> { "absent", "posted" } ]

Init ==
    /\ vote = [ b \in Banks |-> "none" ]
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ pstate = [ b \in Banks |-> "working" ]
    /\ ledger = [ b \in Banks |-> "absent" ]

CastVote(b, v) ==
    /\ vote[b] = "none"
    /\ v \in { "yes", "no" }
    /\ vote' = [ vote EXCEPT ![b] = v ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << decision, pstate, ledger >>

Decide ==
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ \A b \in Banks : vote[b] # "none"
    /\ decision' = IF \A b \in Banks : vote[b] = "yes" THEN "commit" ELSE "abort"
    /\ UNCHANGED << vote, pstate, ledger >>

CommitBank(b) ==
    /\ decision = "commit"
    /\ pstate[b] = "working"
    /\ pstate' = [ pstate EXCEPT ![b] = "committed" ]
    /\ ledger' = [ ledger EXCEPT ![b] = "posted" ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << vote, decision >>

AbortBank(b) ==
    /\ decision = "abort"
    /\ pstate[b] = "working"
    /\ pstate' = [ pstate EXCEPT ![b] = "aborted" ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << vote, decision, ledger >>

Idle ==
    /\ decision # "none"
    /\ \A b \in Banks : pstate[b] # "working"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks, v \in { "yes", "no" } : CastVote(b, v)
    \/ Decide
    \/ \E b \in Banks : CommitBank(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : AbortBank(b)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    \A b \in Banks : pstate[b] = "committed" => ledger[b] = "posted"
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {1, 2, 3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m6p0t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Players, Lobbies, MaxT, Lease

VARIABLES owner, expiry, clock, openL

vars == <<owner, expiry, clock, openL>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [ Lobbies -> Players \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ expiry \in [ Lobbies -> 0 .. MaxT + Lease ]
    /\ clock \in 0 .. MaxT
    /\ openL \subseteq Lobbies

Init ==
    /\ owner = [ l \in Lobbies |-> 0 ]
    /\ expiry = [ l \in Lobbies |-> 0 ]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ openL = Lobbies

Claim(p, l) ==
    /\ l \in openL
    /\ owner[l] = 0
    /\ owner' = [ owner EXCEPT ![l] = p ]
    /\ expiry' = [ expiry EXCEPT ![l] = clock + Lease ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, openL >>

Expire(l) ==
    /\ owner[l] # 0
    /\ expiry[l] <= clock
    /\ owner' = [ owner EXCEPT ![l] = 0 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << expiry, clock, openL >>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, expiry, openL >>

OpenLobby(l) ==
    /\ l \notin openL
    /\ openL' = openL \cup { l }
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, expiry, clock >>

CloseLobby(l) ==
    /\ l \in openL
    /\ owner[l] = 0
    /\ openL' = openL \ { l }
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, expiry, clock >>

Idle ==
    /\ clock = MaxT
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, l \in Lobbies : Claim(p, l)
    \/ \E l \in Lobbies : Expire(l)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E l \in Lobbies : OpenLobby(l)
    \/ \E l \in Lobbies : CloseLobby(l)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LeaseWithinCapacity ==
    \A l \in Lobbies : owner[l] # 0 => l \in openL
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Players = {1, 2}
    Lobbies = {1, 2}
    MaxT = 3
    Lease = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LeaseWithinCapacity

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m5p6t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Robots, Authorized, Actions, Quorum, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES proposal, votes, epoch, robotEpoch, executed

vars == <<proposal, votes, epoch, robotEpoch, executed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ proposal \in Actions \cup { "none" }
    /\ votes \subseteq [ robot : Robots ]
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ robotEpoch \in [ Robots -> 0 .. MaxEpoch ]
    /\ executed \subseteq Actions

Init ==
    /\ proposal = "none"
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ robotEpoch = [ r \in Robots |-> 0 ]
    /\ executed = {}

Propose(a) ==
    /\ proposal = "none"
    /\ a \notin executed
    /\ proposal' = a
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, epoch, robotEpoch, executed >>

CastVote(r) ==
    /\ proposal # "none"
    /\ r \in Authorized
    /\ robotEpoch[r] = epoch
    /\ votes' = votes \cup { [ robot |-> r ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, epoch, robotEpoch, executed >>

Execute ==
    /\ proposal # "none"
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ executed' = executed \cup { proposal }
    /\ proposal' = "none"
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, robotEpoch >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, robotEpoch, executed >>

Sync(r) ==
    /\ robotEpoch[r] < epoch
    /\ robotEpoch' = [ robotEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = epoch ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, votes, epoch, executed >>

Idle ==
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ proposal = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Actions : Propose(a)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : CastVote(r)
    \/ Execute
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Sync(r)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AuthorizedFreshVotes ==
    \A v \in votes : v.robot \in Authorized /\ robotEpoch[v.robot] = epoch
=============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m0p1t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Books, Instances, MaxVer

VARIABLES available, reserved, version, reqs

vars == <<available, reserved, version, reqs>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ available \in [ Books -> BOOLEAN ]
    /\ reserved \in [ Books -> Instances \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ version \in [ Books -> 0 .. MaxVer ]
    /\ reqs \subseteq [ inst : Instances, book : Books, saw : 0 .. MaxVer ]

Init ==
    /\ available = [ b \in Books |-> TRUE ]
    /\ reserved = [ b \in Books |-> 0 ]
    /\ version = [ b \in Books |-> 0 ]
    /\ reqs = {}

Submit(i, b) ==
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup { [ inst |-> i, book |-> b, saw |-> version[b] ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << available, reserved, version >>

Apply(q) ==
    /\ q \in reqs
    /\ q.saw = version[q.book]
    /\ available[q.book] = TRUE
    /\ version[q.book] < MaxVer
    /\ available' = [ available EXCEPT ![q.book] = FALSE ]
    /\ reserved' = [ reserved EXCEPT ![q.book] = q.inst ]
    /\ version' = [ version EXCEPT ![q.book] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ { q }

Stale(q) ==
    /\ q \in reqs
    /\ q.saw # version[q.book]
    /\ reqs' = (reqs \ { q }) \cup { [ inst |-> q.inst, book |-> q.book, saw |-> version[q.book] ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << available, reserved, version >>

Return(b) ==
    /\ reserved[b] # 0
    /\ version[b] < MaxVer
    /\ available' = [ available EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE ]
    /\ reserved' = [ reserved EXCEPT ![b] = 0 ]
    /\ version' = [ version EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED reqs

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, b \in Books : Submit(i, b)
    \/ \E q \in reqs : Apply(q)
    \/ \E q \in reqs : Stale(q)
    \/ \E b \in Books : Return(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RecordConsistent ==
    \A b \in Books : (reserved[b] # 0) <=> (available[b] = FALSE)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Books = {b1, b2}
    Instances = {1, 2}
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RecordConsistent

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m9p2t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Total, MaxCap, MaxEpoch

Zones == { 1, 2, 3 }

CapSchedule(e) == [ z \in Zones |-> IF e = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 3 ]

VARIABLES load, cap, epoch, transfers

vars == <<load, cap, epoch, transfers>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ load \in [ Zones -> 0 .. Total ]
    /\ cap \in [ Zones -> 0 .. MaxCap ]
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ transfers \in 0 .. 6

Init ==
    /\ load = [ z \in Zones |-> IF z = 1 THEN Total ELSE 0 ]
    /\ cap = [ z \in Zones |-> 3 ]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ transfers = 0

MoveRight(z) ==
    /\ z \in { 1, 2 }
    /\ load[z] > 0
    /\ load[z + 1] < cap[z + 1]
    /\ transfers < 6
    /\ load' = [ load EXCEPT ![z] = @ - 1, ![z + 1] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ transfers' = transfers + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << cap, epoch >>

MoveLeft(z) ==
    /\ z \in { 2, 3 }
    /\ load[z] > 0
    /\ load[z - 1] < cap[z - 1]
    /\ transfers < 6
    /\ load' = [ load EXCEPT ![z] = @ - 1, ![z - 1] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ transfers' = transfers + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << cap, epoch >>

RaiseCap(z) ==
    /\ cap[z] < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = [ cap EXCEPT ![z] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << load, epoch, transfers >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ \A z \in Zones : CapSchedule(epoch + 1)[z] >= load[z]
    /\ cap' = CapSchedule(epoch + 1)
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << load, transfers >>

Idle ==
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ transfers = 6
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E z \in Zones : MoveRight(z)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : MoveLeft(z)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : RaiseCap(z)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conserved ==
    load[1] + load[2] + load[3] = Total
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Total = 2
    MaxCap = 3
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conserved

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m5p1t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, Vals, Quorum, MaxUpdates

VARIABLES history, record, proposal, votes, admin

vars == <<history, record, proposal, votes, admin>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ history \in Seq(Vals)
    /\ record \in Vals \cup { 0 }
    /\ proposal \in Vals \cup { 0 }
    /\ votes \subseteq Players
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ history = << >>
    /\ record = 0
    /\ proposal = 0
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ admin = FALSE

Propose(v) ==
    /\ proposal = 0
    /\ proposal' = v
    /\ UNCHANGED << history, record, votes, admin >>

Vote(p) ==
    /\ proposal # 0
    /\ votes' = votes \cup { p }
    /\ UNCHANGED << history, record, proposal, admin >>

Commit ==
    /\ proposal # 0
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ Len(history) < MaxUpdates
    /\ history' = Append(history, proposal)
    /\ record' = proposal
    /\ proposal' = 0
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED admin

AdminSet(v) ==
    /\ admin = TRUE
    /\ Len(history) < MaxUpdates
    /\ history' = Append(history, v)
    /\ record' = v
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, votes, admin >>

ToggleAdmin ==
    /\ admin' = ~admin
    /\ UNCHANGED << history, record, proposal, votes >>

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in Vals : Propose(v)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Vote(p)
    \/ Commit
    \/ \E v \in Vals : AdminSet(v)
    \/ ToggleAdmin

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RecordIsLatest ==
    record = IF history = << >> THEN 0 ELSE history[Len(history)]
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Players = {1, 2, 3}
    Vals = {1, 2}
    Quorum = 2
    MaxUpdates = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RecordIsLatest

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m5p0t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Instances, Members, Quorum

VARIABLES holder, inCS, request, votes

vars == <<holder, inCS, request, votes>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Instances \cup { 0 }
    /\ inCS \in [ Instances -> BOOLEAN ]
    /\ request \in [ Instances -> BOOLEAN ]
    /\ votes \in [ Instances -> SUBSET Members ]

Init ==
    /\ holder = 0
    /\ inCS = [ i \in Instances |-> FALSE ]
    /\ request = [ i \in Instances |-> FALSE ]
    /\ votes = [ i \in Instances |-> {} ]

Raise(i) ==
    /\ request[i] = FALSE
    /\ inCS[i] = FALSE
    /\ request' = [ request EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, inCS, votes >>

Approve(i, m) ==
    /\ request[i] = TRUE
    /\ votes' = [ votes EXCEPT ![i] = @ \cup { m } ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, inCS, request >>

Acquire(i) ==
    /\ request[i] = TRUE
    /\ holder = 0
    /\ Cardinality(votes[i]) >= Quorum
    /\ holder' = i
    /\ inCS' = [ inCS EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE ]
    /\ request' = [ request EXCEPT ![i] = FALSE ]
    /\ votes' = [ votes EXCEPT ![i] = {} ]

Release(i) ==
    /\ inCS[i] = TRUE
    /\ holder' = 0
    /\ inCS' = [ inCS EXCEPT ![i] = FALSE ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << request, votes >>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Raise(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, m \in Members : Approve(i, m)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Acquire(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Release(i)

MutexHeld ==

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m2p4t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Txns, Participants, Capacity

VARIABLES phase, prescVote, invVote, reserved, dispensed, crashed

vars == <<phase, prescVote, invVote, reserved, dispensed, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in [ Txns -> { "voting", "committed", "aborted" } ]
    /\ prescVote \in [ Txns -> { "none", "yes", "no" } ]
    /\ invVote \in [ Txns -> { "none", "yes", "no" } ]
    /\ reserved \in 0 .. Capacity
    /\ dispensed \in 0 .. Capacity
    /\ crashed \subseteq Participants

Init ==
    /\ phase = [ t \in Txns |-> "voting" ]
    /\ prescVote = [ t \in Txns |-> "none" ]
    /\ invVote = [ t \in Txns |-> "none" ]
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ dispensed = 0
    /\ crashed = {}

VotePresc(t, v) ==
    /\ "presc" \notin crashed
    /\ phase[t] = "voting"
    /\ prescVote[t] = "none"
    /\ prescVote' = [ prescVote EXCEPT ![t] = v ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, invVote, reserved, dispensed, crashed >>

VoteInvYes(t) ==
    /\ "inv" \notin crashed
    /\ phase[t] = "voting"
    /\ invVote[t] = "none"
    /\ dispensed + reserved < Capacity
    /\ invVote' = [ invVote EXCEPT ![t] = "yes" ]
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, prescVote, dispensed, crashed >>

VoteInvNo(t) ==
    /\ "inv" \notin crashed
    /\ phase[t] = "voting"
    /\ invVote[t] = "none"
    /\ invVote' = [ invVote EXCEPT ![t] = "no" ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, prescVote, reserved, dispensed, crashed >>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = { p }
    /\ UNCHANGED << phase, prescVote, invVote, reserved, dispensed >>

CommitTxn(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "voting"
    /\ prescVote[t] = "yes"
    /\ invVote[t] = "yes"
    /\ phase' = [ phase EXCEPT ![t] = "committed" ]
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed + 1
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << prescVote, invVote, crashed >>

AbortTxn(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "voting"
    /\ \/ prescVote[t] = "no"
       \/ invVote[t] = "no"
       \/ ("presc" \in crashed /\ prescVote[t] = "none")
       \/ ("inv" \in crashed /\ invVote[t] = "none")
    /\ phase' = [ phase EXCEPT ![t] = "aborted" ]
    /\ reserved' = IF invVote[t] = "yes" THEN reserved - 1 ELSE reserved
    /\ UNCHANGED << prescVote, invVote, dispensed, crashed >>

Idle ==
    /\ \A t \in Txns : phase[t] # "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Txns, v \in { "yes", "no" } : VotePresc(t, v)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : VoteInvYes(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : VoteInvNo(t)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Crash(p)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : CommitTxn(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : AbortTxn(t)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected ==
    dispensed + reserved <= Capacity
=============================================================================

    Txns = {1, 2}
    Participants = {"presc", "inv"}
    Capacity = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected

VARIABLES held, version, reqs, releases

    /\ held \in [ Instances -> SUBSET Cranes ]
    /\ version \in [ Cranes -> 0 .. MaxVer ]
    /\ reqs \subseteq [ inst : Instances, crane : Cranes, saw : 0 .. MaxVer ]
    /\ releases \in 0 .. MaxRel

Init ==
    /\ held = [ i \in Instances |-> {} ]
    /\ version = [ c \in Cranes |-> 0 ]
    /\ reqs = {}
    /\ releases = 0

Submit(i, c) ==
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup { [ inst |-> i, crane |-> c, saw |-> version[c] ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << held, version, releases >>

Apply(q) ==
    /\ q \in reqs
    /\ q.saw = version[q.crane]
    /\ \A i \in Instances : q.crane \notin held[i]
    /\ version[q.crane] < MaxVer
    /\ held' = [ held EXCEPT ![q.inst] = @ \cup { q.crane } ]
    /\ version' = [ version EXCEPT ![q.crane] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ { q }
    /\ UNCHANGED releases

Stale(q) ==
    /\ q \in reqs
    /\ q.saw # version[q.crane]
    /\ reqs' = (reqs \ { q }) \cup { [ inst |-> q.inst, crane |-> q.crane, saw |-> version[q.crane] ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << held, version, releases >>

Release(i, c) ==
    /\ c \in held[i]
    /\ version[c] < MaxVer
    /\ releases < MaxRel
    /\ held' = [ held EXCEPT ![i] = @ \ { c } ]
    /\ version' = [ version EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ releases' = releases + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED reqs

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, c \in Cranes : Submit(i, c)
    \/ \E q \in reqs : Apply(q)
    \/ \E q \in reqs : Stale(q)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, c \in Cranes : Release(i, c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CranesDisjoint ==
    \A i, j \in Instances : i # j => (held[i] \cap held[j]) = {}

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m5p1t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Runways, Flights, Controllers, Quorum

VARIABLES assignment, commitLog, proposal, votes, admin

vars == <<assignment, commitLog, proposal, votes, admin>>

Entries == [ runway : Runways, flight : Flights ]
Props == [ active : BOOLEAN, runway : Runways, flight : Flights ]

TypeOK ==
    /\ assignment \in [ Runways -> Flights \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ commitLog \subseteq Entries
    /\ proposal \in Props
    /\ votes \subseteq Controllers
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ assignment = [ r \in Runways |-> 0 ]
    /\ commitLog = {}
    /\ proposal = [ active |-> FALSE, runway |-> CHOOSE r \in Runways : TRUE, flight |-> CHOOSE f \in Flights : TRUE ]
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ admin = FALSE

Propose(r, f) ==
    /\ proposal.active = FALSE
    /\ assignment[r] = 0
    /\ proposal' = [ active |-> TRUE, runway |-> r, flight |-> f ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << assignment, commitLog, votes, admin >>

Vote(c) ==
    /\ proposal.active = TRUE
    /\ votes' = votes \cup { c }
    /\ UNCHANGED << assignment, commitLog, proposal, admin >>

Commit ==
    /\ proposal.active = TRUE
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ assignment' = [ assignment EXCEPT ![proposal.runway] = proposal.flight ]
    /\ commitLog' = commitLog \cup { [ runway |-> proposal.runway, flight |-> proposal.flight ] }
    /\ proposal' = [ proposal EXCEPT !.active = FALSE ]
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED admin

AdminAssign(r, f) ==
    /\ admin = TRUE
    /\ assignment[r] = 0
    /\ assignment' = [ assignment EXCEPT ![r] = f ]
    /\ commitLog' = commitLog \cup { [ runway |-> r, flight |-> f ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, votes, admin >>

ToggleAdmin ==
    /\ admin' = ~admin
    /\ UNCHANGED << assignment, commitLog, proposal, votes >>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Runways, f \in Flights : Propose(r, f)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Vote(c)
    \/ Commit
    \/ \E r \in Runways, f \in Flights : AdminAssign(r, f)
    \/ ToggleAdmin

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BackedByLog ==
    \A r \in Runways :
        assignment[r] # 0 => [ runway |-> r, flight |-> assignment[r] ] \in commitLog
=============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m8p6t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Players, Authorized, Regions, Lobbies, MaxEpoch

RegionOf(lb) == IF lb <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2

VARIABLES regionLock, lobbyLock, session, epoch

vars == <<regionLock, lobbyLock, session, epoch>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ regionLock \in [ Regions -> Players \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ lobbyLock \in [ Lobbies -> Players \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ session \in [ Players -> 0 .. MaxEpoch ]
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch

Init ==
    /\ regionLock = [ rg \in Regions |-> 0 ]
    /\ lobbyLock = [ lb \in Lobbies |-> 0 ]
    /\ session = [ p \in Players |-> 0 ]
    /\ epoch = 0

AcquireRegion(p, rg) ==
    /\ p \in Authorized
    /\ session[p] = epoch
    /\ regionLock[rg] = 0
    /\ regionLock' = [ regionLock EXCEPT ![rg] = p ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << lobbyLock, session, epoch >>

AcquireLobby(p, lb) ==
    /\ p \in Authorized
    /\ session[p] = epoch
    /\ regionLock[RegionOf(lb)] = p
    /\ lobbyLock[lb] = 0
    /\ lobbyLock' = [ lobbyLock EXCEPT ![lb] = p ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << regionLock, session, epoch >>

ReleaseAll(p) ==
    /\ regionLock' = [ rg \in Regions |-> IF regionLock[rg] = p THEN 0 ELSE regionLock[rg] ]
    /\ lobbyLock' = [ lb \in Lobbies |-> IF lobbyLock[lb] = p THEN 0 ELSE lobbyLock[lb] ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << session, epoch >>

BumpEpoch ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ regionLock' = [ rg \in Regions |-> 0 ]
    /\ lobbyLock' = [ lb \in Lobbies |-> 0 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED session

Renew(p) ==
    /\ p \in Authorized
    /\ session[p] < epoch
    /\ session' = [ session EXCEPT ![p] = epoch ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << regionLock, lobbyLock, epoch >>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, rg \in Regions : AcquireRegion(p, rg)
    \/ \E p \in Players, lb \in Lobbies : AcquireLobby(p, lb)
    \/ \E p \in Players : ReleaseAll(p)
    \/ BumpEpoch
    \/ \E p \in Players : Renew(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleUnauthorizedLocks ==
    /\ \A rg \in Regions : regionLock[rg] # 0 =>
           ( regionLock[rg] \in Authorized /\ session[regionLock[rg]] = epoch )
    /\ \A lb \in Lobbies : lobbyLock[lb] # 0 =>
           ( lobbyLock[lb] \in Authorized
             /\ session[lobbyLock[lb]] = epoch
             /\ regionLock[RegionOf(lb)] = lobbyLock[lb] )
=============================================================================

InQueue(j) == \E i \in DOMAIN queue : queue[i] = j

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m7p1t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences

RECURSIVE SumSeq(_)
SumSeq(s) == IF s = << >> THEN 0 ELSE Head(s) + SumSeq(Tail(s))

TypeOK ==
    /\ stock \in 0 .. MaxCap
    /\ ver \in 0 .. MaxVer
    /\ ledger \in Seq({ -1, 1 })
    /\ capacity \in 0 .. MaxCap
    /\ reqs \subseteq [ delta : { -1, 1 }, saw : 0 .. MaxVer ]

    /\ ledger' = Append(ledger, m.delta)
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ { m }
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

StaleCAS(m) ==

    /\ m.saw # ver

    \/ \E m \in reqs : StaleCAS(m)
    \/ \E k \in 0 .. MaxCap : AdjustCap(k)

    /\ clock \in 0 .. MaxT

    /\ assigned = [ b \in Bays |-> 0 ]
    /\ lease = [ b \in Bays |-> 0 ]
    /\ results = [ c \in Cars |-> "pending" ]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ crashed = {}

Assign(b, c) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ assigned[b] = 0
    /\ results[c] = "pending"
    /\ \A b2 \in Bays : assigned[b2] # c
    /\ assigned' = [ assigned EXCEPT ![b] = c ]
    /\ lease' = [ lease EXCEPT ![b] = clock + LeaseLen ]

    \/ \E b \in Bays : Reclaim(b)
    \/ Tick

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m9p2t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Branches, Total, MaxEpoch

RECURSIVE SumF(_, _)
SumF(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE e \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumF(f, S \ { x })

VARIABLES atBranch, inTransit, epoch, branchEpoch

vars == <<atBranch, inTransit, epoch, branchEpoch>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ atBranch \in [ Branches -> 0 .. Total ]
    /\ inTransit \in 0 .. Total
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ branchEpoch \in [ Branches -> 0 .. MaxEpoch ]

Init ==
    /\ atBranch = [ b \in Branches |-> IF b = 1 THEN Total ELSE 0 ]
    /\ inTransit = 0
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ branchEpoch = [ b \in Branches |-> 0 ]

Ship(b) ==
    /\ branchEpoch[b] = epoch
    /\ atBranch[b] > 0
    /\ atBranch' = [ atBranch EXCEPT ![b] = @ - 1 ]
    /\ inTransit' = inTransit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, branchEpoch >>

Receive(b) ==
    /\ inTransit > 0
    /\ atBranch' = [ atBranch EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ inTransit' = inTransit - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, branchEpoch >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << atBranch, inTransit, branchEpoch >>

Sync(b) ==
    /\ branchEpoch[b] < epoch
    /\ branchEpoch' = [ branchEpoch EXCEPT ![b] = epoch ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << atBranch, inTransit, epoch >>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Ship(b)
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Receive(b)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Sync(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conserved ==
    SumF(atBranch, Branches) + inTransit = Total
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Branches = {1, 2}
    Total = 2
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conserved

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m2p1t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Txns, Participants, InitBal

Delta == [ t \in Txns |-> IF t = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 ]

RECURSIVE SumF(_, _)
SumF(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE e \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumF(f, S \ { x })

VARIABLES votes, txnState, balance, journal, admin

vars == <<votes, txnState, balance, journal, admin>>

MaxBal == InitBal + SumF(Delta, Txns)

TypeOK ==
    /\ votes \in [ Txns -> [ Participants -> { "none", "yes", "no" } ] ]
    /\ txnState \in [ Txns -> { "voting", "committed", "aborted" } ]
    /\ balance \in 0 .. MaxBal
    /\ journal \subseteq Txns
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ votes = [ t \in Txns |-> [ p \in Participants |-> "none" ] ]
    /\ txnState = [ t \in Txns |-> "voting" ]
    /\ balance = InitBal
    /\ journal = {}
    /\ admin = FALSE

Vote(t, p, v) ==
    /\ txnState[t] = "voting"
    /\ votes[t][p] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [ votes EXCEPT ![t][p] = v ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << txnState, balance, journal, admin >>

Commit(t) ==
    /\ txnState[t] = "voting"
    /\ \A p \in Participants : votes[t][p] = "yes"
    /\ txnState' = [ txnState EXCEPT ![t] = "committed" ]
    /\ balance' = balance + Delta[t]
    /\ journal' = journal \cup { t }
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, admin >>

AdminCommit(t) ==
    /\ admin = TRUE
    /\ txnState[t] = "voting"
    /\ txnState' = [ txnState EXCEPT ![t] = "committed" ]
    /\ balance' = balance + Delta[t]
    /\ journal' = journal \cup { t }
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, admin >>

Abort(t) ==
    /\ txnState[t] = "voting"
    /\ \E p \in Participants : votes[t][p] = "no"
    /\ txnState' = [ txnState EXCEPT ![t] = "aborted" ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, balance, journal, admin >>

ToggleAdmin ==
    /\ admin' = ~admin
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, txnState, balance, journal >>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Txns, p \in Participants, v \in { "yes", "no" } : Vote(t, p, v)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Commit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : AdminCommit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Abort(t)
    \/ ToggleAdmin

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    balance = InitBal + SumF(Delta, journal)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Txns = {1, 2}
    Participants = {1, 2}
    InitBal = 0
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
